name: The Beatles

whyMatters.en: Liverpool four-piece that moved from Invasion singles to album-as-unit and studio-as-instrument between 1963 and 1969; default settings later rock keeps rewriting.
whyMatters.zh: 利物浦四人组：1963–1969 从 Invasion 单曲走到「专辑为单元」与「录音室即乐器」；后来摇滚不断改写的默认设置由此定下。

essentialTracks.title: I Want to Hold Your Hand

scenes.track: I Want to Hold Your Hand

note.en: Orchestral climax: pop form meets studio modernism.
note.zh: 管弦高潮：流行形式遇见录音室现代主义。

note.en: Harrison writing share rising inside the four.
note.zh: 四人组内部 Harrison 写作份额上升。

interviewQuotes.speaker: Paul McCartney

lyricQuotes: Living is easy with eyes closed

shortBio.en: Lennon / McCartney / Harrison / Starr; Hand to A Day in the Life spans pop and studio peak.
shortBio.zh: Lennon / McCartney / Harrison / Starr；从 Hand 到 A Day in the Life 跨越流行与录音室高峰。

body.en:
Formed 1960 (Hamburg/Cavern apprenticeship). EMI years with George Martin run from beat-group hits through Rubber Soul, Revolver, Sgt. Pepper, White Album, Abbey Road—multitrack, tape edits, orchestral overdubs.

I Want to Hold Your Hand (1963) and A Day in the Life (1967) bookend invasion pop and studio modernism. Personnel is stable; method is not.
body.zh:
1960 年组建（汉堡/Cavern 学徒期）。与 George Martin 的 EMI 年代从 beat 热单经 Rubber Soul、Revolver、Sgt. Pepper、白专、Abbey Road——多轨、磁带剪辑、管弦叠加。

I Want to Hold Your Hand（1963）与 A Day in the Life（1967）标记 Invasion 流行与录音室现代主义两端。人事稳定；方法不稳。

body.en:
The Beatles matter less as a finished style than as a sequence of defaults: two-guitar beat group, album cohesion, studio experiment. Later rock inherits the ambitions even when rejecting the sound.

Coordinates, not a museum freeze.
body.zh:
Beatles 要紧处不在完成一种风格，而在一串默认：双吉他 beat 组合、专辑凝聚力、录音室实验。后来摇滚即使拒绝其声音也继承其野心。

是坐标，不是博物馆冻结。

title.en: Four names as a calendar unit
title.zh: 四个名字当作日历单元

body.en:
Classic four is the memory lock. Roles shift inside—Harrison’s writing rises, Starr’s feel anchors—but the cast barely changes until the end.

Stability of names, volatility of method.
body.zh:
经典四人是记忆锁定。内部角色有变——Harrison 写作上升、Starr 的手感锚定——但人马直到结束几乎不变。

名字稳定，方法动荡。

title.en: I Want to Hold Your Hand: Invasion switch
title.zh: I Want to Hold Your Hand：Invasion 开关

body.en:
US chart breakthrough single; Capitol push and TV appearances turn UK beat into a continental event.

Song craft is still short-form pop; the scale of distribution is the news.
body.zh:
打进美国榜的突破单曲；Capitol 推送与电视亮相把英国 beat 变成跨洋事件。

歌曲工艺仍是短形式流行；分发尺度才是新闻。

body.en:
From Revolver onward: tape loops, varispeed, orchestral climax (A Day in the Life), modular sessions. Live touring ends; records become the primary performance.

Beach Boys’ Pet Sounds and UK peers sit in the same production arms race.
body.zh:
自 Revolver 起：磁带循环、变速、管弦高潮（A Day in the Life）、模块化录音。巡演停止；唱片成为主要表演。

Beach Boys 的 Pet Sounds 与英国同辈处在同一制作军备竞赛。

body.en:
Harmony stacks, middle-eight craft, album sequencing, and studio permission travel into metal, punk (as refusal), and indie (as citation).

Not a finish line—a map other bands navigate.
body.zh:
和声堆叠、中八工艺、专辑排序与录音室许可权，传入金属、朋克（作为拒绝）与 indie（作为引用）。

不是终点线——是其他乐队导航的地图。

body.en:
Interview lines and press myths are abundant; useful ones describe process—who wrote what, how a take was built.

Prefer craft detail over aura.
body.zh:
访谈句与媒体神话极多；有用的描述过程——谁写了什么、一条 take 如何搭成。

宁取工艺细节，不取光环。

note.en: Default Invasion lineup frozen in global memory.
note.zh: 全球记忆中冻结的默认 Invasion 阵容。
